# ctr only: remove the matching names of every unused image; when that leaves the image without any name, remove its bare
# sha256 record too (otherwise the CRI keeps listing it as <none>)
sudo crictl --runtime-endpoint unix:///run/bench68660550/containerd.sock --image-endpoint unix:///run/bench68660550/containerd.sock ps -a -o json > /tmp/bench68660550-ps.json
sudo crictl --runtime-endpoint unix:///run/bench68660550/containerd.sock --image-endpoint unix:///run/bench68660550/containerd.sock images -o json > /tmp/bench68660550-images.json
python3 - <<'PY' > /tmp/bench68660550-plan.txt
import json, re
ps = json.load(open("/tmp/bench68660550-ps.json"))["containers"]
used = {c["imageRef"] for c in ps}
for img in json.load(open("/tmp/bench68660550-images.json"))["images"]:
    tags = img.get("repoTags", [])
    match = [t for t in tags if re.search("foo|bar", t)]
    if not match or img["id"] in used:
        continue
    others = [t for t in tags if t not in match]
    for t in match:
        print("rm", t)
    if not others:
        print("rm", img["id"])
PY
cat /tmp/bench68660550-plan.txt
while read -r _ ref; do sudo ctr -a /run/bench68660550/containerd.sock -n k8s.io images rm "$ref"; done < /tmp/bench68660550-plan.txt

# the command of the question: every matching image goes, whether a container uses it or not
sudo crictl --runtime-endpoint unix:///run/bench68660550/containerd.sock --image-endpoint unix:///run/bench68660550/containerd.sock images | grep -E -- 'foo|bar' | awk '{print $3}' | xargs -n 1 sudo crictl --runtime-endpoint unix:///run/bench68660550/containerd.sock --image-endpoint unix:///run/bench68660550/containerd.sock rmi

# prune everything that no container uses: the filter 'foo|bar' is ignored (web-cache:1 and release-pin:1 go too)
sudo crictl --runtime-endpoint unix:///run/bench68660550/containerd.sock --image-endpoint unix:///run/bench68660550/containerd.sock rmi --prune

# unused + matching, removed with crictl rmi: it removes the image with all its names, release-pin:1 included
sudo crictl --runtime-endpoint unix:///run/bench68660550/containerd.sock --image-endpoint unix:///run/bench68660550/containerd.sock ps -a -o json > /tmp/bench68660550-ps.json
sudo crictl --runtime-endpoint unix:///run/bench68660550/containerd.sock --image-endpoint unix:///run/bench68660550/containerd.sock images -o json > /tmp/bench68660550-images.json
python3 - <<'PY' > /tmp/bench68660550-plan.txt

ps = json.load(open("/tmp/bench68660550-ps.json"))["containers"]
